findings.highlight: It was only a two-second delay, but that was more than enough time for Rider to "wind up."
findings.evidenceJa: わずか二秒の間隙だったが、それでも、ライダーにとっては充分すぎる“助走距離”を引き離せた。
findings.governingReading: Two-second delay lets Rider gain enough run-up distance; following line fixes50 meters.
findings.explanation: Gaining run-up distance becomes having time to wind up.

findings.highlight: A giant red eyeball appears in front of her.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の前面に、赤い血で結ばれた巨大な眼が現れる。
findings.governingReading: This intact occurrence again specifies eye formed with red blood.
findings.explanation: Blood-formed eye lost in chain-opening branch too.

findings.highlight: Four petals scatter the black light,
findings.evidenceJa: 黒い極光に打ち砕かれた四枚羽を撒き散らしながら、
findings.governingReading: Four petals broken by black aurora scatter before white light wins.
findings.explanation: Broken shield petals become black-light-scattering petals in other branch.

findings.evidenceJa: ベルレフォーンの光はその九割を、セイバーの聖剣によって相殺された。
findings.governingReading: Japanese says Saber's holy sword cancels nine tenths of Bellerophon's light.
findings.explanation: Ninety-percent cancellation line absent from chain-opening English.
